data.exact_reserve_text: The result included a release from prior year reserves of GBP 32.4m (2014, GBP 33.6m release). This release is a result of the Markel strategy to reserve prudently, more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 737.531m. During 2015 the Syndicate reports a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 32.4m, driven by more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the Managing Agent's prudent reserving posture and active claims handling. No gross prior-year movement amount was explicitly disclosed in the technical movement notes, so the quantified prior-year development reported in the narrative is net of reinsurance.
